checkpoint_selection: lowest VALIDATION behavior MSE per training seed/configuration
matched_budget: each model draws the common d>=1 TRAIN behavior row count per validation round without replacement; same optimizer steps per round
normalization: TRAIN behavior only, same suffix0/1 for each representation; no target normalization
reference_reproduction: retrain Z and P with exact G4 behavior-only fit code and compare validation selection to frozen G4 Z0/P0
validation_subset_selection_model: Z+subset, three-seed mean metrics; lexicographic Q95 false-safe rate, candidate RMSE, negative pairwise accuracy, safe-choice regret, group count, dimension
